text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Frohes neues Jahr!
Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now then, please take this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tilted their head while receiving the present, and upon looking inside—tilted their head even further.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is a confection made in the shape of a pig,
a Glücksschwein.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It means "lucky pig"—
Please accept it as a gift celebrating the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say this year is the most important year of my life.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the Classic Triple Crown—the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.
To walk the right path, I will not back down on this.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I put my heartfelt wishes into this,
so that you can make it through this rugged path safely."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's made of marzipan, so
once you're done admiring it, you can eat it too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I drew everything myself,
starting from the base concept sketches for the blueprint.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No, the beta version right before this one, well.
Let me rephrase. Regarding the illustrations,
Falcon-san's input has been incorporated as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. At first, I gathered 360-degree photos of pigs
and created a realistic illustration, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I was advised that it was 'too realistic and scary,
so make it a bit cuter...'"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, I do not have much experience
with chibi-style illustrations...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I tried internalizing it in my own way,
...but it seems I wasn't very good at it.
choice_data_list: ...It definitely looked like a pig to me!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Well, that's a relief, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I haven't prepared anything
to give Eishin Flash in return.
As I wonder what to do—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's just a token of my feelings, so there's no need for a return gift.
Though if I had to ask for something...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In order to run safely through this entire year,
I would like to know if Japan has any customs
similar to the Glücksschwein.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Most things done in the new year are meant to pray for a safe and sound year. Which means what we should introduce here is—
choice_data_list: Praying for growth with kite flying!
Praying for Good Health with Osechi!
Declare our resolutions with New Year's calligraphy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many traditions associated with kite flying,
but this time, I explained the belief that flying a kite high into the sky is a prayer for a person's growth.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see... That sounds intriguing.
Shall we give it a try right away?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer,
look! A kite is flying!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, I will check!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her run while looking up at the kite,
I couldn't help but feel a warm, fond smile come over me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dishes in osechi hold various meanings.
I suggested eating them to pray for good health throughout the year.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was of course aware of its existence...
but lacked knowledge on the finer details.
Please, do tell me more.

text_block_list.name: Ryotei Staff
text_block_list.text: Here is our ryotei's specialty osechi.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...! This is...
It's packed tightly with all sorts of small dishes—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's so adorable.
Even more than that... it's beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She gazed at the osechi with sparkling eyes.
It seemed to suit her tastes, and she happily
listened to the clerk's explanation afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that facing calligraphy with a sincere heart
and writing down one's feelings
serves as a way to refocus on one's goals.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So it carries ritualistic significance as well.
In that case, I shall take on this challenge with utmost seriousness.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —It is finished.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wrote down...
"Eishin Flash (Eishin Sen'yo)."
choice_data_list: And the meaning behind that is...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A while back, Gold Ship-san taught me
how to write my name in kanji. And then—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Flashing fiercely and soaring up in an instant"...
I've realized it carries a truly wonderful meaning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Please look after Eishin Flash this year as well, Trainer-san.
